title: Well-set refusals: the closed keys a refused well set names (reason "well-set:<key>"), in two sections: the reader's shape keys and the Gateway's keys (E119a)

sections.description: The shape of the document, read by the Connectors reader without a coordinate library or a project lookup. A sentence that starts in lower case follows "Member <n> " (counted from 1) or "The set ".

keys.sentence: A well set is at most 256 KiB.
A well set is one JSON object in UTF-8 text.
has a field that well-set/1 does not read.
misses a field that well-set/1 requires.
The document does not say "schema": "ophiolite.well-set/1".
The label must be text of 1 to 80 characters.
A well set has 1 to 29 members.
is not an object with well, wellbore, trajectory and frame.
does not name a well and a wellbore by their project ids.
names a wellbore an earlier member already names.
names its trajectory without an asset id and a revision.
has a frame but no trajectory; a frame places a trajectory.
has a trajectory but no frame; the frame says where it starts and how it is oriented.
states its coordinate system other than as EPSG:<code>.
holds a value that is not a finite number.
names its depth reference or datum other than as text of 1 to 64 characters.
gives its depth reference elevation above an unknown datum; name the datum.
does not say how its azimuths relate to grid north (frame.north).
states its survey basis other than as true-north or grid:EPSG:<code>.
rotates its azimuths by more than 10 degrees either way.
is surveyed on the grid of its own coordinate system, so its rotation must be 0.
ties in at a measured depth that is not above 0.
describes its source in more than 200 characters.

sections.description: What only the Gateway can decide: the readable label, saving on this deployment, the one request, and from slice 1 the private ceiling, each member's well, wellbore and trajectory, rights and the coordinate system.

keys.sentence: Well sets cannot be saved on this deployment yet.
A well set is saved in one request, not in parts.
Use a label people can read, such as Groningen residual wells.
A well set stays with its author in this version.
You cannot read the well this member names.
You cannot read the wellbore this member names, or it was removed.
The wellbore is not part of the well this member names.
The trajectory revision does not belong to the wellbore this member names.
The trajectory is not a deviation survey.
The trajectory revision was withdrawn.
You can read the trajectory but not use it in your own results.
The rights to use the trajectory ended.
The rights recorded for the trajectory do not allow results derived from it.
The trajectory has no rights record.
The coordinate system is not a projected one.
The coordinate system does not have metre axes.
A member changed while the set was being saved; nothing was saved. Try again.
A well set is not made by a procedure.
